newsitem.title: GREECE: IONIAN BANK CUTS BASE LOAN RATES JAN 15.
newsitem.headline: IONIAN BANK CUTS BASE LOAN RATES JAN 15.

text.p: State Ionian Bank announced on Friday cuts in its business, housing and consumer loan rates effective January 15.
Its base lending rate for working capital loans to business will fall by 100 basis points to 17.5 percent. Likewise for its base rate for fixed asset loans.
Ionian will also lower the rate on its floating-rate mortgages by 50 basis points down to 15.0 percent. Its fixed-rate mortgages will come down by 100 basis points to 12.0 percent, it said.

Ionian's consumer loan rates will drop to 20.75-22.5 percent from 21.0-23.5 percent previously as regards personal loans. Loans for household goods will also drop to 19.5-21.75 from 21.0-23.5 percent.
Auto loan rates will be cut by 125 basis points to 18.5 percent.
Ionian said all loans were subject to a 1.0 percent rate surcharge as per law 128/75. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
